calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, multiply its 20-session return known at t-1 by the cross-sectional breadth known at t-1, defined as the fraction of the 15-asset universe with positive 20-session returns minus 0.5. Positive breadth confirms continuation and negative breadth reverses the momentum orientation in broad bearish regimes. All inputs are lagged before the 10-session forward return evaluation.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark gates using the 15-asset cross-section. Predictive strength improved materially in the recent 365, 180, and 60-session windows; interpret uncertainty conservatively given the small cross-section. Full coverage and moderate signal turnover.
